rule: Active (not Removed) charities on the CCNI register that tick Preschool (0-5), Children (5-13) or Youth (14-25) under "Who the charity helps", or Playgroup/after schools under "How the charity works". These are SELF-DECLARED ticks: 4,028 of 8,376 charities tick Children, including churches and grammar schools, so this is the outer bound, not the sector. registerTier: children-only = ticks only children/youth/preschool/parents. Figures are the latest return as filed; income etc. in £ as on the register.
coverageGap: Charities registered in England and Wales or Scotland that operate in NI (Barnardo's, NSPCC, Action for Children, Save the Children: none on this register) are absent; CCNI registration is still being phased in.
